reasoning: The icon depicts the standard mobile UI symbol for cellular data (up and down transfer arrows) crossed out by a diagonal slash, meaning mobile data off or no data connection. While primarily a status indicator, it fits tasks about disabling cellular data for travel, restricting background data, testing offline mode in software, or troubleshooting a broken mobile data connection. Out of context, the two opposite arrows can be mistaken for sort order or elevator arrows.
